description: Build a generic MCP Apps chart from one or more FXMacroData endpoint families: arbitrary plots, multi-series charts, and actual-vs-consensus views that combine announcements with predictions. Supported series sources are announcements, predictions, forex, commodities, and cot; `source=rate_differential` with base and quote charts two policy rates and their spread. For example, USD policy-rate midpoint actuals against market consensus use one announcements series for `usd/policy_rate_midpoint` and one predictions series for `usd/policy_rate_midpoint` with `prediction_class=forecaster_survey`. It only charts FXMacroData data; it never fetches arbitrary URLs or runs custom chart code. Access: USD is available without an API key; every other currency returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

base.description: Base currency for single-series forex plots. Supported: any lowercase 3-letter ISO code in the FXMacroData catalogue, for example usd, eur, gbp, jpy.

chart_kind.description: Initial chart view. Supported: line, area, bar, dot, step.

currency.description: Single-series currency for announcements, predictions, or COT. Supported macro currencies: any lowercase 3-letter ISO code in the FXMacroData catalogue, for example usd, eur, gbp, jpy. Supported COT currencies: AUD, CAD, CHF, EUR, GBP, JPY, NZD, USD, XAU.

indicator.description: Single-series indicator for announcements, predictions, or commodities. Supported macro indicators: any indicator slug the FXMacroData catalogue lists for the currency, for example inflation, gdp, policy_rate, unemployment. Supported commodity indicators: crude_oil_inventories, distillate_inventories, gasoline_inventories, gold, natural_gas, natural_gas_storage, oil_brent, oil_wti, platinum, silver.

limit.description: Maximum rows per source. Defaults to 20; maximum 100.

prediction_source.description: Optional prediction source filter for prediction series.

prediction_type.description: Optional legacy prediction-type filter for prediction series. Superseded by prediction_class.

query.description: Optional natural-language request to preserve in the payload title/context.
examples: plot USD policy-rate midpoint actual vs market consensus

quote.description: Quote currency for single-series forex plots. Supported: any lowercase 3-letter ISO code in the FXMacroData catalogue, for example usd, eur, gbp, jpy.

series.description: Optional list of series specs. Each spec supports `source` (announcements, predictions, forex, commodities, cot), `currency`, `indicator`, `base`, `quote`, `label`, `y_key`, `metric`, `prediction_class`, `prediction_source`, `start_date`, `end_date`, `limit`, `offset`, and `page`.

source.description: Single-series source when `series` is omitted. Supported values: announcements, predictions, forex, commodities, cot, rate_differential (needs base and quote).

title.description: Optional chart title. Defaults to query or an auto-generated title.

x_axis.description: Field to use as the shared x-axis. Supported: date, announcement_datetime, announcement_datetime_local, generated_at, observation_datetime.

y_key.description: Single-series metric field. Defaults by source: val for announcements and commodities, predicted_value for predictions, rate for forex, noncommercial_net for COT.

y_label.description: Optional y-axis label for the chart.
